items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey ruled out mid-game with concussion after early exit/evaluation.
items.why: Head injury evaluation in second quarter; quick rule-out. Follows prior foot issues.
items.implication: Enters concussion protocol; next availability uncertain (Chargers have bye Week 7). Limited remaining targets in offense.
items.opportunity: Immediate target bump to other LAC WRs (Johnston etc.) and RBs in pass game.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore inactive (shoulder); Josh Palmer active.
items.implication: No BUF WR targets from Moore; Palmer elevated.
items.opportunity: Target share bump for other Bills WRs/TEs.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins inactive after GTD/questionable ankle status. Browns depth limited to Jaleel McLaughlin and Audric Estime (recent PS signee).
items.why: Pregame workout/status determination led to inactive; practiced once this week.
items.implication: Zero fantasy production; handcuff/backup RBs elevated for CLE backfield.
items.opportunity: Full backfield opportunity shift to remaining CLE RBs on limited depth.

items.text: Tyler Warren inactive (groin). Tyjae Spears active opposite.
items.why: Late-week groin strain; Colts inactives confirm.
items.implication: Remove from lineups; IND TE usage redistributes.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/targets for other IND TEs/pass-catchers; Spears gets Titans RB work.

items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts placed on IR (superficial blood clot in calf); out indefinitely, Tanner McKee starts.
items.why: Official roster move; condition dates to Week 4.
items.implication: No rushing upside from McKee; multi-week absence possible.
items.opportunity: Dameon Pierce elevated for Barkley (also out) workload; Smith active.

items.text: Cam Skattebo still preferred NYG RB start for explosiveness/score chance vs NO but now riskier flex (updated RB28) post-rotation news favoring Najee larger role.
items.why: Fumbles led to expected role change; preseason hate list context.
items.implication: Flex over RB2; monitor actual snaps.
items.opportunity: Still mixed in; upside if involved early.
items.conflict: Levitan highlights poor YOE/fumbles supporting downgrade.

items.text: Cam Skattebo downgraded in Giants RB rotation amid poor efficiency (37th/43 in rush YOE) and 4 fumbles; Najee Harris expected larger role, all 4 RBs active.
items.why: Sources indicate rotation change post-fumbles; data backs inefficiency.
items.implication: Riskier flex/RB2; reduced carries likely vs prior.
items.opportunity: Najee/others gain share; Skattebo still mixed but explosiveness remains upside path.
items.conflict: Berry still prefers starting Cam for explosiveness vs NO but ranks as riskier flex (RB28).

items.text: Caleb Williams expected to play/active after hamstring; confirmed in actives.
items.why: Full practices and expected; Schefter actives confirm.
items.implication: Bears QB1 returns; unlocks offense projections.
items.opportunity: Full snaps for CHI pass-catchers (Odunze, Burden, Loveland).

items.text: Chris Olave and Alvin Kamara expected to play/active.
items.why: Weekend reports listed expected; Schefter actives.
items.implication: Full or near roles in NO offense.

items.text: A.J. Brown and TreVeyon Henderson expected/active for Patriots.
items.why: Reports of likely play then confirmed active; Brown activated to 53.
items.implication: Brown full workload return; Henderson mixed with Stevenson.
items.opportunity: NE pass game boost with Brown; Henderson shares carries.

items.text: Watching Davante Adams (leg) among Sunday injuries; status for potential impact.
items.implication: Monitor for LAR WR usage if limited/out.
items.opportunity: If out, boost to other Rams WRs (Nacua etc.).

items.text: Dalton Kincaid (ribs) returned to game after injury.
items.why: Listed as returned in watch list.

items.text: Loves Kyren Williams (RB5) vs ARI for elite recent usage and leaking run defense.
Loves Javonte Williams (RB8) @ GB for volume and goal-line role vs soft run D.
